bull_bear.body:
- Largest news broadcasting network in India — 20 channels across 10+ languages, #1 both in reach and viewership share, reaching over 230 million people every month with a 13.8% viewership share
- All three national channels — CNBC-TV18, CNN-News18 and News18 India — have been leaders in their respective markets for multiple years
- Brand trust built over years in an increasingly cluttered news environment is described by management as an asset of enduring value
- #1 digital news and information publishing network in India with a monthly reach of ~350 million across own and third-party platforms
- Moneycontrol is India's largest financial news subscription platform, with engagement metrics of approximately twice the page views and time-spent of its closest competitor
- One of the most extensive news-gathering and distribution infrastructures in the country
- Network synergies — diversified portfolio across languages, formats and geographies enables integrated content engines and cross-platform amplification, reducing the probability of simultaneous underperformance across all markets
- Long track record of strategic alliances with leading international media companies including NBCU, CNN, A+E Networks and Forbes
- Strategic investments in leading media brands — Studio18 Media (which holds a stake in JioStar), BookMyShow and, until it ceased to be an associate, Eenadu Television
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Content and brand risk — Success in media depends on the choice of subject matter and quality of treatment; consumer preferences evolve continually and shifts are visible only over the long term, making future success hard to predict. Revenues from any content are directly linked to viewership and audience interest, so content that fails to resonate creates a risk of revenue loss. Consumers associate each Network18 brand with certain types of content, and any event that damages a brand can adversely impact the business — brand strength is described as among the Company's most valuable assets.
- Technology risk — The pace of technological change has accelerated across the media sector, where new business models have emerged and viewing habits have been fundamentally transformed. The entire content value chain from news gathering and production to distribution is increasingly technology-driven, directly affecting content presentation, working efficiencies and operational costs, creating an ongoing challenge to remain current and pick the right technical solutions.
- Cybersecurity risk — Growth of the digital economy has increased opportunities for cyber criminals to infiltrate sensitive IT infrastructure through phishing and other malicious practices, while advances in Generative AI create a new risk frontier by enabling automated vulnerability discovery and exploitation and supply chain attacks. The Company aligns its IT security landscape with the NIST framework and is ISO 27001-2022 certified.
- Regulatory and compliance risk — The Indian regulatory landscape for media is constantly evolving across distribution, taxation and content censorship, and reporting requirements under SEBI, MCA and taxation laws have increased manifold. Any change by TRAI or the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting requires proactive realignment of corporate performance objectives alongside compliance with new requirements.
- Financing risk — short-term debt concentration — All of the Company's debt consists of short-term debt raised from capital markets, exposing it to the risk of capital unavailability due to macroeconomic factors such as liquidity conditions, interest rate volatility and the broader economic environment.
- Human resource / key-talent risk — The Company's ability to operate effectively and implement its business strategies depends in part on the continued contributions of its executive officers and other key employees, who may be difficult to replace, retain or recruit amid intense competition and scarcity of specialist talent in media and entertainment.
- Advertising demand and macroeconomic risk — The MD&A forward-looking statement names the important factors that could influence the Company's operations: geo-political and economic developments, demand and supply conditions in the industry, input prices, changes in government regulations and tax laws, and other factors such as litigation.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Network18 Media & Investments Ltd. is India's largest news network with a presence across television, digital and other allied businesses. It operates a TV news bouquet of 20 channels spanning business news, national news in English and Hindi, and regional news across India, and a digital portfolio of websites and mobile applications covering general, business, opinion, hyperlocal and global news. It monetises this through advertising revenue and subscription income, serving advertisers and audiences across languages, genres and screens, and holds strategic investments in other leading Indian media platforms.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Business news:** CNBC-TV18, CNBC-AWAAZ, CNBC Bajar, CNBC-TV18 Prime, CNBC-TV18 ACCESS
- **National news:** News18 India, CNN-News18
- **Regional news:** News18 Marathi, News18 MP Chhattisgarh, News18 Bihar Jharkhand, News18 Punjab Haryana, News18 Jammu Kashmir Ladakh, News18 Delhi-NCR
- **International news:** News18 International
- **Digital:** Moneycontrol, Moneycontrol Pro, Moneycontrol Super Pro, News18.com, CNBC-TV18 (digital), Firstpost, Creator18, Tools18
- **Print and online magazines:** Forbes India, Overdrive
- **Factual entertainment:** History TV18

business.title: Competitive strengths

outlook.body:
- Be the one-stop news destination for every Indian — a platform-agnostic provider of news content across languages and regions
- Fortify leadership in the news business and expand thoughtfully into adjacent categories in the coming year
- Diversify revenue streams and future-proof growth by building new products and platforms such as Moneycontrol Super Pro and Creator18
- Expand the regional footprint and local journalism, evidenced by the launch of News18 Delhi-NCR
- Sustain and deepen international content alliances — the CNN partnership was renewed for a third decade during the year
- Build a more agile, resilient and future-ready organisation in response to a turbulent geopolitical environment, stressed advertising budgets and shifting consumer behaviour
- Grow scale on digital and YouTube, where the network is India's largest news presence
- Leverage strategic investments in Studio18 Media, BookMyShow and other media platforms to strengthen competitive position
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: Network18 is an asset-light media business and discloses no manufacturing capacity or plant expansion; its build-out is in channels, digital products and technology infrastructure. During FY26 it launched CNBC-TV18 Prime (launched May 2025) as a new business-intelligence channel and News18 Delhi-NCR, extending its regional footprint, and rebranded News18 Lokmat as News18 Marathi in early 2026. On digital, the Company says it is continually expanding content coverage across its portfolio and upgrading its technology infrastructure to become a one-stop digital destination; the year saw the launch of Moneycontrol Super Pro, the premium subscription offering for active investors, the launch of secured lending in the Moneycontrol Fintech vertical supported by integrations with leading partners, and expansion of Moneycontrol's coverage of unlisted shares. News18.com expanded its utility ecosystem with Tools18, audio news, interactive formats, enriched city experiences and in-house interactive games, with investments in AI Studio and Feed Management System 2.0 to improve editorial productivity and scalability, plus AI-driven recommendations, 'Ask AI search', automated cricket liveblogs and CDP-led personalisation. Structurally, News18 Marathi Private Limited became a wholly owned subsidiary after acquisition of the balance stake from Lokmat Media Private Limited, and the Board approved its amalgamation into the Company subject to NCLT sanction. The Company states it is not engaged in manufacturing activities, is not an energy intensive unit, and incurred no expenditure on Research and Development during the year.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Management expects to benefit from policy measures and broader economic initiatives aimed at reviving consumer demand
- Advertising budgets are described as stressed and consumer behaviours as shifting, alongside the growing spread of disinformation — headwinds management flags for the year ahead
- The FY26 revenue base was distorted by a high base of election-linked advertising in the first quarter; excluding that quarter revenue grew faster
- A diversified media franchise across genres, screens, languages, geographies and formats is presented as the source of resilience against industry-wide weakness
- Trust and credibility in an information-contested environment is positioned as the durable demand driver for premium news inventory
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers

Management will focus in the coming year on raising the performance bar, fortifying leadership in the news business, and expanding thoughtfully into adjacent categories.
The Company intends to build new revenue streams through subscription and 'News+' products while expanding reach across television, digital and Connected TV platforms.
The Company is making sustained investments in content capabilities, digital products and technology infrastructure.

The Board approved the Scheme of amalgamation of News18 Marathi Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, with the Company, subject to sanction of the Mumbai Bench of the National Company Law Tribunal.
The Company is building new products and platforms — Moneycontrol Super Pro, Creator18 and News18 Delhi-NCR — to diversify its business and revenue streams.
Management flags a turbulent and uncertain geopolitical environment accompanied by stressed advertising budgets, shifting consumer behaviours and the growing spread of disinformation.
The Company is continually expanding its content coverage across its digital portfolio and upgrading its technology infrastructure to become a one-stop digital destination.
The Moneycontrol Fintech vertical launched secured lending in FY 2025-26, supported by integrations with leading partners, building a foundation for further scaling of the business.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Network18 Media & Investments Ltd. is India's largest news network with a presence across television, digital and other allied businesses. It operates a TV news bouquet of 20 channels spanning business news, national news in English and Hindi, and regional news across India, and a digital portfolio of websites and mobile applications covering general, business, opinion, hyperlocal and global news. It monetises this through advertising revenue and subscription income, serving advertisers and audiences across languages, genres and screens, and holds strategic investments in other leading Indian media platforms.

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Business news:** CNBC-TV18, CNBC-AWAAZ, CNBC Bajar, CNBC-TV18 Prime, CNBC-TV18 ACCESS
- **National news:** News18 India, CNN-News18
- **Regional news:** News18 Marathi, News18 MP Chhattisgarh, News18 Bihar Jharkhand, News18 Punjab Haryana, News18 Jammu Kashmir Ladakh, News18 Delhi-NCR
- **International news:** News18 International
- **Digital:** Moneycontrol, Moneycontrol Pro, Moneycontrol Super Pro, News18.com, CNBC-TV18 (digital), Firstpost, Creator18, Tools18

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- India — pan-India television news audiences across 10+ languages
- Indian regional markets including Maharashtra, UP/Uttarakhand, Bihar/Jharkhand, Karnataka, West Bengal, Gujarat, Orissa, MP/Chhattisgarh, Punjab/Haryana, Jammu Kashmir Ladakh and Delhi-NCR
- Advertisers seeking brand-safe, high-attention news inventory across linear TV, digital and Connected TV
- Retail investors and market participants (financial news subscriptions and fintech)
- Indian diaspora and international audiences via News18 International and Firstpost

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Management expects to benefit from policy measures and broader economic initiatives aimed at reviving consumer demand
- Advertising budgets are described as stressed and consumer behaviours as shifting, alongside the growing spread of disinformation — headwinds management flags for the year ahead
- The FY26 revenue base was distorted by a high base of election-linked advertising in the first quarter; excluding that quarter revenue grew faster
- A diversified media franchise across genres, screens, languages, geographies and formats is presented as the source of resilience against industry-wide weakness
- Trust and credibility in an information-contested environment is positioned as the durable demand driver for premium news inventory

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Be the one-stop news destination for every Indian — a platform-agnostic provider of news content across languages and regions
- Fortify leadership in the news business and expand thoughtfully into adjacent categories in the coming year
- Diversify revenue streams and future-proof growth by building new products and platforms such as Moneycontrol Super Pro and Creator18
- Expand the regional footprint and local journalism, evidenced by the launch of News18 Delhi-NCR
- Sustain and deepen international content alliances — the CNN partnership was renewed for a third decade during the year
- Build a more agile, resilient and future-ready organisation in response to a turbulent geopolitical environment, stressed advertising budgets and shifting consumer behaviour
- Grow scale on digital and YouTube, where the network is India's largest news presence
- Leverage strategic investments in Studio18 Media, BookMyShow and other media platforms to strengthen competitive position

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: Network18 is an asset-light media business and discloses no manufacturing capacity or plant expansion; its build-out is in channels, digital products and technology infrastructure. During FY26 it launched CNBC-TV18 Prime (launched May 2025) as a new business-intelligence channel and News18 Delhi-NCR, extending its regional footprint, and rebranded News18 Lokmat as News18 Marathi in early 2026. On digital, the Company says it is continually expanding content coverage across its portfolio and upgrading its technology infrastructure to become a one-stop digital destination; the year saw the launch of Moneycontrol Super Pro, the premium subscription offering for active investors, the launch of secured lending in the Moneycontrol Fintech vertical supported by integrations with leading partners, and expansion of Moneycontrol's coverage of unlisted shares. News18.com expanded its utility ecosystem with Tools18, audio news, interactive formats, enriched city experiences and in-house interactive games, with investments in AI Studio and Feed Management System 2.0 to improve editorial productivity and scalability, plus AI-driven recommendations, 'Ask AI search', automated cricket liveblogs and CDP-led personalisation. Structurally, News18 Marathi Private Limited became a wholly owned subsidiary after acquisition of the balance stake from Lokmat Media Private Limited, and the Board approved its amalgamation into the Company subject to NCLT sanction. The Company states it is not engaged in manufacturing activities, is not an energy intensive unit, and incurred no expenditure on Research and Development during the year.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Largest news broadcasting network in India — 20 channels across 10+ languages, #1 both in reach and viewership share, reaching over 230 million people every month with a 13.8% viewership share
- All three national channels — CNBC-TV18, CNN-News18 and News18 India — have been leaders in their respective markets for multiple years
- Brand trust built over years in an increasingly cluttered news environment is described by management as an asset of enduring value
- #1 digital news and information publishing network in India with a monthly reach of ~350 million across own and third-party platforms
- Moneycontrol is India's largest financial news subscription platform, with engagement metrics of approximately twice the page views and time-spent of its closest competitor
- One of the most extensive news-gathering and distribution infrastructures in the country
- Network synergies — diversified portfolio across languages, formats and geographies enables integrated content engines and cross-platform amplification, reducing the probability of simultaneous underperformance across all markets
- Long track record of strategic alliances with leading international media companies including NBCU, CNN, A+E Networks and Forbes
- Strategic investments in leading media brands — Studio18 Media (which holds a stake in JioStar), BookMyShow and, until it ceased to be an associate, Eenadu Television

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Content and brand risk — Success in media depends on the choice of subject matter and quality of treatment; consumer preferences evolve continually and shifts are visible only over the long term, making future success hard to predict. Revenues from any content are directly linked to viewership and audience interest, so content that fails to resonate creates a risk of revenue loss. Consumers associate each Network18 brand with certain types of content, and any event that damages a brand can adversely impact the business — brand strength is described as among the Company's most valuable assets.
- Technology risk — The pace of technological change has accelerated across the media sector, where new business models have emerged and viewing habits have been fundamentally transformed. The entire content value chain from news gathering and production to distribution is increasingly technology-driven, directly affecting content presentation, working efficiencies and operational costs, creating an ongoing challenge to remain current and pick the right technical solutions.
- Cybersecurity risk — Growth of the digital economy has increased opportunities for cyber criminals to infiltrate sensitive IT infrastructure through phishing and other malicious practices, while advances in Generative AI create a new risk frontier by enabling automated vulnerability discovery and exploitation and supply chain attacks. The Company aligns its IT security landscape with the NIST framework and is ISO 27001-2022 certified.
- Regulatory and compliance risk — The Indian regulatory landscape for media is constantly evolving across distribution, taxation and content censorship, and reporting requirements under SEBI, MCA and taxation laws have increased manifold. Any change by TRAI or the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting requires proactive realignment of corporate performance objectives alongside compliance with new requirements.
- Financing risk — short-term debt concentration — All of the Company's debt consists of short-term debt raised from capital markets, exposing it to the risk of capital unavailability due to macroeconomic factors such as liquidity conditions, interest rate volatility and the broader economic environment.
- Human resource / key-talent risk — The Company's ability to operate effectively and implement its business strategies depends in part on the continued contributions of its executive officers and other key employees, who may be difficult to replace, retain or recruit amid intense competition and scarcity of specialist talent in media and entertainment.
- Advertising demand and macroeconomic risk — The MD&A forward-looking statement names the important factors that could influence the Company's operations: geo-political and economic developments, demand and supply conditions in the industry, input prices, changes in government regulations and tax laws, and other factors such as litigation.

themes.title: Media, entertainment & out-of-home advertising
themes.need: Digital-content, music-IP licensing and an advertising-recovery cycle underpin media - TIPSMUSIC on music IP; ZEEL/ENIL/RADIOCITY/BTML on broadcast/content; HTMEDIA/DBCORP/HMVL on print + digital; SIGNPOST/BRIGHT-tier and UFO on OOH/cinema.
